name: Bayesian structural time series (BSTS)
summary: A Bayesian state-space model with trend, seasonality and automatic regressor selection; also used to estimate event effects.
inputs: Target series, optional many candidate regressors (or control series for causal impact).
outputs: Posterior forecasts with intervals; inclusion probabilities of regressors; estimated intervention effect.

data_requirements.min_observations: Enough pre-period history to learn the relationship

assumptions: Series decomposes into state components (trend, seasonality, regression)
For causal impact: control series are unaffected by the intervention and the relationship is stable
math_summary: A structural state-space model with trend, seasonal and regression components; spike-and-slab priors select among many candidate regressors, and MCMC gives a posterior predictive distribution.
when_to_use: Estimating the effect of an event or policy on a series when no randomised control exists
pitfalls: Causal claims rest on untestable assumptions about controls
Check the license for the R bsts package before bundling

applicability.use_case: Estimated effect of a policy change on regional electricity consumption
Nowcasting a quarterly macro series from monthly indicators

materials.title: Scott & Varian (2014), Predicting the present with Bayesian structural time series
materials.why: Introduces BSTS with spike-and-slab regressor selection for nowcasting.
